title: The Amazing Spider-Man #1
description: The origin of Spider-Man! When teenager Peter Parker is bitten by a radioactive spider, he gains incredible powers. But with great power comes great responsibility.

title: Avengers Assemble
description: Earth's Mightiest Heroes unite to face threats too great for any single hero to handle. Iron Man, Thor, Captain America and more join forces.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
description: In a dystopian future, the X-Men must change the past to prevent their dark fate. A time-traveling adventure featuring Wolverine and the team.

title: Civil War
description: Heroes are divided when a Superhuman Registration Act forces them to choose sides. Iron Man leads those who support it, Captain America leads the resistance.

title: Infinity Gauntlet
description: Thanos has assembled the Infinity Stones and threatens all of existence. The universe's heroes must unite to stop the Mad Titan's apocalyptic plan.

title: The Dark Phoenix Saga
description: Jean Grey's transformation into the Dark Phoenix threatens the entire universe. The X-Men face their most powerful and tragic battle.

title: Secret Wars
description: Heroes and villains are transported to Battleworld by the Beyonder. They must fight for survival in the ultimate cosmic confrontation.

title: Captain America: Winter Soldier
description: Cap faces a mysterious assassin from his past. The Winter Soldier's true identity will shake Steve Rogers to his core.

title: Thor: God of Thunder
description: Thor battles across time against Gorr the God Butcher. Three versions of Thor must unite to save the gods themselves.

title: The Incredible Hulk #181
description: First full appearance of Wolverine! The Hulk battles the mysterious Canadian agent with adamantium claws.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 1
description: Star-Lord assembles a ragtag team of cosmic misfits. Together they protect the galaxy from threats both galactic and personal.

title: Doctor Strange: Sorcerer Supreme
description: Stephen Strange defends Earth from mystical threats. Journey through dimensions as the Sorcerer Supreme faces dark magic.

title: Black Panther: A Nation Under Our Feet
description: T'Challa faces rebellion in Wakanda. As king and hero, he must unite his nation against internal and external threats.

title: Iron Man: Extremis
description: Tony Stark upgrades his armor with revolutionary nanotech. But the Extremis virus falls into dangerous hands.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
description: Matt Murdock's life is destroyed by the Kingpin. He must rebuild from nothing to reclaim his role as the Devil of Hell's Kitchen.

title: Fantastic Four #1
description: Marvel's First Family! Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm and Ben Grimm gain fantastic powers from cosmic radiation.

title: The Mighty Thor: The Unworthy Thor
description: Thor is no longer worthy to wield Mjolnir. He must discover why and reclaim his power as the God of Thunder.

title: Hawkeye: My Life as a Weapon
description: Clint Barton's life without the Avengers. A street-level adventure featuring everyone's favorite archer and his protégé Kate Bishop.

title: Black Widow: Web of Intrigue
description: Natasha Romanoff faces her past as a spy. Her history with the Red Room comes back to haunt her.

title: Ant-Man: The Astonishing Ant-Man
description: Scott Lang juggles being a father, ex-con, and size-changing superhero. Comedy and action collide in the Marvel Universe's smallest hero.

title: The Punisher: Welcome Back, Frank
description: Frank Castle returns to New York to wage his one-man war on crime. No mercy, no prisoners, only punishment.

title: Deadpool: The Good, The Bad and The Ugly
description: Wade Wilson's healing factor and fourth-wall breaking humor make him Marvel's Merc with a Mouth. Maximum effort, maximum chaos.

title: Moon Knight: From the Dead
description: Marc Spector serves as the fist of the Egyptian god Khonshu. Psychological thriller meets superhero action.

title: Luke Cage: Power Man
description: Carl Lucas gains unbreakable skin and superhuman strength. He becomes Luke Cage, Hero for Hire, protecting Harlem.

title: Jessica Jones: Alias
description: Former superhero turned private investigator. Jessica Jones uses her powers and detective skills to help people with superpowered problems.

title: Venom: Lethal Protector
description: The alien symbiote and Eddie Brock become the antihero Venom. Brutal justice against those who prey on the innocent.

title: Silver Surfer: Parable
description: The Herald of Galactus questions his role. A philosophical journey across the cosmos examining power and responsibility.

title: She-Hulk: Single Green Female
description: Jennifer Walters is a lawyer by day, jade giant by necessity. Breaking the fourth wall and legal precedents.

title: Captain Marvel: Higher, Further, Faster
description: Carol Danvers embraces her role as one of the universe's most powerful heroes. Earth's defender reaches for the stars.

title: Spider-Gwen: Most Wanted
description: In another universe, Gwen Stacy was bitten by the radioactive spider. Now she's the spectacular Spider-Woman of Earth-65.
